observations.dispute_text: An annualised month reported by the press or the company, not booked or audited revenue, and often sourced to the company itself.
observations.note: The year-earlier reading for the data-seller panel. 'This summer' in an October 2025 piece is dated at the end of August 2025 (a judgement call).
observations.raw_snippet: Within just a few months, Lord was taking a victory lap this summer, going on a mini tour of the podcast circuit to explain how Handshake AI went from 15 people to 150, growing revenue from nothing to an annualized run rate of $100 million in just eight months.
